1.why: Four unrelated event nouns with no cluster, register split, or shared dimension; nothing eliminable.

2.why: unread/misquoted/contested are three flavours of the same negative-reception frame, so none can be uniquely right; 'celebrated' is the only positive and the odd term.

3.why: calculated/sincere/habitual describe the motive behind an act and 'uncomfortable' describes a feeling, but the split is 1-3 on a weak axis.

4.why: No synonym cluster; 'exact' is arguably the only non-social adjective but the set is otherwise clean.

5.why: understated/rounded pair on magnitude and disputed/unpublished pair on status; a 2-2 split names no centre.

6.why: All four describe a delivery along different axes; 'mechanical' is the only figurative one, which is thin.

7.why: rival/witness/judge are adversarial or adjudicative roles and 'sponsor' is the only supporter, but three are not synonyms.

8.why: Four common adjectives on four independent dimensions; no structural tell.

9.why: praise/provoke/imitate are responses to another person's conduct and 'escort' is physical accompaniment, but escort still takes a person object.

10.why: All four share the adverb+participle frame and vary only the content word; the frame is uniform so nothing is eliminable.

11.why: polite/curious/hopeful are three open, positive-facing dispositions that would all satisfy the same stem; 'guarded' is the only reserved term.

12.why: 'eager to please', 'slow to anger' and 'quick to recover' are all temperament idioms; 'hard to find' is availability, a different category.

13.why: location/quality/timing are attributes of the thing itself; 'luck' is the only external, non-attributable factor.

14.why: Four negative traits on unrelated axes; no cluster and no register break.

15.why: postpone/hasten are antonyms and record/approve are unrelated verbs; a 2-2 split gives no centre.

16.why: anxious/weary/rude are states or manner and 'evasive' is conduct under questioning, but the split is weak.

17.why: tangled/faded/soaked are three accidental conditions a thing falls into; 'trimmed' is the only deliberate, agentive participle.

18.why: Four unrelated traits with no synonym cluster or specificity mismatch.

19.why: patient/humble/willing are three attitude dispositions that would satisfy one stem equally; 'skillful' is the only ability term.

20.why: fundamentals/strategy/conditioning are abstract mass training concepts; 'scrimmages' is the only concrete countable activity, a specificity break.

21.why: recall/perform/explain are three things one does with knowledge; 'doubt' is the only attitude rather than an action.

22.why: A, B and C are clean antonym pairs (experimental/conventional, impersonal/intimate, austere/lavish); 'hurried . . . polished' is the only pair not built as a contrast along one axis.

23.why: Four hardship nouns with no cluster; 'solitude' is the only non-deprivation but that is not decisive.

24.why: costly/widespread/brief measure extent or cost and 'harmless' is valence, but the three are not near-synonyms.

25.why: confusing/costly/permanent are three negative consequences that would all fit one stem; 'profitable' is the only positive, so the cluster names it.

26.why: wilted/scorched/overgrown are things that happen to a plant unattended; 'repotted' is the only deliberate agentive act, same tell as item 17.

27.why: coincidence/misunderstanding are accidental and precaution/routine deliberate; a 2-2 split names no centre.

28.why: Four adjectives on unrelated dimensions; nothing distinguishes them without the stem.

29.why: provisional/outdated/unofficial are three ways a document lacks standing; 'illegible' is the only physical-readability term.

30.why: 'short . . . extend' is the only pair whose second word remedies the condition the first names; the other three pairs have no relation between their halves.
